All Bizzness Sports / Privacy

Privacy policy.

This notice explains how the All Bizzness Sports website handles information when you browse the site, use the live scoreboard, or follow an external link.

Last updated: October 1, 2026 · Effective date: October 1, 2026

1. What this site collects

All Bizzness Sports is currently a public sports podcast and community site. It does not currently offer user accounts, social sign-in, checkout, payment processing, comment forms, newsletters, or a site-hosted contact form.

Information you provide

If you contact All Bizzness Sports through an external platform linked from this site, that platform receives and handles the information you choose to submit under its own privacy terms.

Technical information

The hosting, content-delivery, and security providers supporting the site may process technical request data such as an IP address, browser and device details, referring URL, requested page, timestamp, and security events. This information is used by those providers to deliver and protect the website.

2. Scoreboard and external services

When the live scoreboard is available, the browser requests current game data from an external sports-data API. The API provider may receive ordinary technical request data and handles it under its own terms and privacy practices.

The site also links to Facebook, YouTube, Davidson Digital Design, and other third-party pages. Those sites are separate services. Their collection, cookies, and use of information are controlled by their own policies once you leave All Bizzness Sports.

3. Cookies and browser storage

All Bizzness Sports does not currently run Google Analytics, advertising pixels, or optional analytics cookies. The site does not activate an optional tracker when you click “Accept optional cookies.”

The Cookie settings control stores your choice in this browser so the preference can be remembered. You can clear that preference through your browser’s site-data controls. Hosting or security providers may use their own technical mechanisms to deliver or protect the site.

Current setting: no optional analytics or advertising tracker is active on this site.

Use to review the current preference.

4. How information is used

  • To deliver pages, images, video, and the site’s navigation.
  • To display current scoreboard information when that feature is available.
  • To maintain reliability, prevent abuse, and protect the site and its visitors.
  • To remember the browser’s cookie-preference choice.

All Bizzness Sports does not sell personal information through this website.

5. Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live, applicable law may give you rights to ask what personal information is held about you, request correction or deletion, restrict or object to certain processing, or withdraw consent where consent is the legal basis.

The current public contact route for All Bizzness Sports is the official Facebook page. A dedicated privacy email address has not been provided for this build, so one has not been invented here.

6. Security and retention

Reasonable technical measures are used in the site and hosting configuration, but no internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. All Bizzness Sports does not maintain an account database or store submissions through a site-hosted form. Provider-managed technical logs are retained according to the relevant provider’s configuration and policies.

7. Children’s privacy

This public site is not directed to children under 13, and All Bizzness Sports does not knowingly request personal information from children through this site.

8. Changes to this notice

This notice may be updated when the site’s features, providers, or information practices change. The “Last updated” date at the top will be changed when a material revision is published.
